reference.coordinate_convention: normalized image coordinates, origin top-left, x rightward, y downward

left_ceiling_side_top_frame.notes: Measured from the visible left wall/ceiling seam extrapolated to the top frame on the canonical reference.

right_ceiling_side_top_frame.notes: Measured from the visible right wall/ceiling seam extrapolated to the top frame on the canonical reference.

room_window_drapes.notes: Includes curtain envelope used as architecture/camera marker.

room_bed.notes: Visible bed mass including headboard/mattress/blanket envelope; partly occluded by Celine in reference.

room_foreground_table.notes: Only the near foreground/table band should dominate the bottom edge; it must not bisect the room mid-frame.

room_reference_foreground_laptop.notes: Dominant reference laptop silhouette including clipped lower edge. Exact four-corner solve on the 1016x813 CALL stage is TL=(164.5,689.3), TR=(840.6,696.8), BR=(813.1,812.3), BL=(192.0,812.3); bbox values here are intentionally not used as a substitute for that quadrilateral.

room_reference_foreground_plant.notes: Large near-camera potted plant at the foreground-table right edge. It is a separate visible reference object from room_plant_small on the bedside cabinet. Missing entirely in Real Candidate #1184 and therefore the largest currently documented unfilled geometry envelope. Refine the foliage silhouette from real proof rather than treating this first bbox as pixel-exact.

room_reference_foreground_candle.notes: Near-camera glass candle on foreground-table left; currently missing. Flame/glow are material/light detail after its coarse geometry envelope exists.

room_reference_right_wall_art.notes: Large framed artwork on right wall; currently missing.

room_reference_left_wall_art_pair.notes: Combined visible envelope of the two narrow framed prints on the left wall. Direct reference re-measurement excludes overlapping plant foliage: the older bottom=0.334 coarse bbox over-read plant occlusion. Reliable visible frame edges end around y=0.271. Split into per-frame measurements before final detail acceptance.

room_round_mirror.notes: Mirror is clipped by left image edge in the reference.

room_nightstand_rear.notes: Rear/left bedside Nachttisch.glb is visible behind the bed around the bedside lamp. Top and horizontal envelope are measured from the reference; the bed occludes the lower cabinet/legs, so bottom/height are coarse floor-contact extrapolations and must not override direct visual inspection.

room_nightstand_front.notes: Right nightstand is clipped by the right edge.

room_plant_small.notes: Small right-side plant; partially blended with nightstand/bed edge.
